assessment.scope: Data support for the next animal PK and K. pneumoniae PK/PD analyses
assessment.opinion: Source-specific animal PK fitting can begin conditionally; common-record index ranking remains blocked, while panel-specific target work needs defined effects.

MODEL_BASED_ANIMAL_PK.source_scope: S05/S02 mouse group curves usable; S21 rat timing and S22 rabbit held.
MODEL_BASED_ANIMAL_PK.finding: Source-specific group models can start; rat time origin and mouse dose basis need resolution, and rabbit timing/count discrepancies limit component assessment.
MODEL_BASED_ANIMAL_PK.next_step: Fit eligible curves at their data level; resolve held source timing and dose definitions.

PD_INDEX_COMPARISON.source_scope: S01 Kp-T/Kp-C/Kp-A held; S02 Table 3 lacks paired indices.
PD_INDEX_COMPARISON.finding: S01 has separate plotted pairs but no verified common response identities or marker doses; its dose ranges conflict with tolerability text.
PD_INDEX_COMPARISON.next_step: Seek original common-record and regimen mapping before fitting a shared comparison.

PD_TARGET_ESTIMATION.source_scope: S01 within-panel pairs candidate; S02 responses unpaired with exposure; S09 strain allocation held.
PD_TARGET_ESTIMATION.finding: Each S01 panel has published-simulation exposure-response pairs; target effects and reference definitions need selection, and obscured markers cannot support numerical fitting.
PD_TARGET_ESTIMATION.next_step: Define stasis, one-log and two-log effects; assess each eligible panel within its published basis.

NCA.source_scope: S05/S02 sampled mouse means candidate; S21 rat and S22 rabbit boundaries held.
NCA.finding: Sampled mean peaks may be described; finite AUC needs a chosen window and boundary treatment, while terminal clearance needs qualified tail and route-specific inputs.
NCA.next_step: Specify endpoint and window, then assess each source's boundaries and terminal inputs.

PTA.source_scope: Prospective K. pneumoniae scenarios pending; surveillance MIC distribution remains separate.
PTA.finding: PTA awaits a qualified PK source, effect-specific PD target and frozen compatible MIC inputs; a published panel coordinate is no population probability.
PTA.next_step: Define scenarios after PK and target outputs, then assess variability and MIC-bin coverage.
